ownerDecision.request: Completely redesign Type 100 as an original Chinese infantry fighting vehicle.
ownerDecision.scope: Replace the prior composite tank-like design with a coherent first-party IFV. The photograph guides visual hierarchy, not dimensions or exact hardware identification.

type100.silhouette: Broad straight-shouldered Chinese heavy IFV, shallow prow, rear troop compartment and compact chamfered autocannon turret with four low guided cells
